narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Each angle is sixty degrees, like the six triangles round a point!
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Sixty degrees fits six times round a point, not eight times.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Eight of them would overlap well past a full turn.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>One eighth of a full turn is half a right angle, and bisecting builds it.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Your turn. Bisect every angle again, and find the angle between sixteen lines.
